data.description: Live in the Heart of Marina | 2BR | High Demand
data.long_description:
Experience modern waterfront living in this well-maintained 2-bedroom apartment located in the iconic Torch Tower, Dubai Marina. Offering a generous layout and stunning urban views, this home is perfect for families or professionals seeking comfort, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle.

Property Details:

Size: 1,258.41 sqft
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 3
Status: Ready to Move In

Apartment Features:

Bright and spacious living and dining area
Two well-sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
Three bathrooms (including guest bathroom)
Fully fitted kitchen with ample storage
Floor-to-ceiling windows allowing natural light
Balcony with community and Marina views
High-quality finishes throughout

Building Amenities:

24/7 security and concierge service
Fully equipped gymnasium
Temperature-controlled swimming pool
Sauna and steam rooms
High-speed elevators
Covered parking

Location Highlights:

Prime location in Dubai Marina
Walking distance to Marina Walk, restaurants, and cafes
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
Close to public transport including tram and metro
The Torch Tower is one of the most sought-after residential buildings in Dubai Marina, known for its excellent facilities and vibrant surroundings. This apartment offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience.
